newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Grolsch tumbles after weak 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Grolsch tumbles after weak 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in brewer Grolsch NV tumbled 11.00 guilders or 14 percent to 63.00 in early trade on Wednesday after the company announced profits at the low end of expectations and added that 1997's result would be even worse.
Grolsch said 1996 net profits edged up to 59.9 million guilders from 58.8 million the year before. Analysts had been expecting a range between 59.2 and 66.9 million guilders.
It said it saw insufficient room to raise selling prices in several important beer markets during 1997.
"The results were bad but the outlook was even worse," one dealer said. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
